description: This file contains unit tests for the apiClient service functions fetchApodToday and fetchApodByDate. It mocks fetch calls and verifies correct URL construction and fetch invocation.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets environment variable for backend URL and mocks the global fetch function before each test.

methods.name: afterEach
methods.description: Restores the original fetch function after each test.

methods.name: test('fetchApodToday hits /apod without query')
methods.description: Verifies that fetchApodToday calls fetch with the correct URL and no query parameters.

methods.name: test('fetchApodByDate includes apod_date query only')
methods.description: Checks that fetchApodByDate constructs the URL with the correct date parameter and calls fetch.
